# Solo Money Tools

> The complete MONEYFORGE catalog: 108 premium kits plus 9 free installable PWAs for freelancers, traders and solo operators. Built by a one-person company running on AI agents. Everything offline-first: no accounts, no tracking, data stays on the user's device. One-time purchases, instant download, 30-day money-back guarantee.

## Free apps (installable PWAs at https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/)

- [Trader's Risk & Journal OS](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/traders-risk-journal/): position sizer, trade journal, equity curve, profit-factor stats. Your data never leaves your device.
- [Freelancer Toolkit](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/freelancer-toolkit/): invoices, clients, expenses — the daily drivers of a solo business.
- [Cold Email Generator](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/cold-email-gen/): outreach drafts structured to get replies, not spam flags.
- [Contract Redliner](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/contract-redline/): flags risky clauses before you sign. 17-point risk scan.
- [Client Boundary Coach](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/client-boundary-coach/): scripts for saying no professionally — scope, discounts, weekend pings.
- [Client Onboarding Kit](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/client-onboarding-kit/): kickoff checklists and welcome flows that look like an agency sent them.
- [Focus Timer](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/focus-timer/): deep-work sessions with session stats that survive bad weeks.
- [Rate Checker](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/rate-checker/): your real minimum hourly rate after taxes, expenses and non-billable time.
- [Habit Tracker](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/habit-tracker/): streak logic built for real life, not perfect people.
